name: HUP iEEG Epilepsy Dataset

cohort.types: SEEG 38 / ECoG 20; temporal 25, MTL 17, frontal 10; lesional 27 / non-lesional 30

modalities: Ictal (208 runs) and interictal (111 runs) iEEG, 25.7 h; 256–1024 Hz; median 118 channels
format: BIDS 1.4 EDF; electrodes.tsv + coordsystem.json for 57 subjects
labels: channels.tsv status_description = soz / resect / resect,soz; events.tsv 'sz onset'/'sz offset' for all 208 seizures
outcomes: Success 36 / failure 22; Engel sub-classes; therapy resection 29 / laser ablation 29
caveats: coordsystem.json says fsaverage (units m) but the README says ICBM152 MNI space: check before mapping
381 of 6,921 electrode rows have n/a coordinates (scalp channels)
Possible patient overlap with PennEPI, Multi-Expert and Penn 3T-7T (same centre)
checks: Cloned git tree: participants (58), 57 electrodes/coordsystem files, 319 channels files, 208 events files.
pipeline: The V4 real-surgery dataset from R1/R2: coordinates + SOZ + resected channels + Engel in one open package.
key_claim: Open iEEG with coordinates, SOZ and resection labels per channel, and Engel outcomes for 58 patients.

evidence.quote: Electrophysiologic data for both interictal and ictal periods is available, as are electrode localizations in ICBM152 MNI space.
which was rigorously determined by segmenting the resection cavity
